Initiative & public health portfolio

Health knowledge grounded in humanity.

Ruang Tanpa Stigma is a digital health education initiative founded by Sifa Abdul Rijman to make HIV information easier to understand, more human, and more relevant to communities in Indonesia.

Our story

Why should this space exist?

Medical information can explain a virus, but it does not always address how fear, language, privacy, and other people’s responses shape a person’s experience.

Ruang Tanpa Stigma begins with a simple belief: communities need accurate HIV information without losing the human story. This website is both a learning space and a public health practice portfolio—not a claim to speak for everyone living with HIV.

Our current status

Ruang Tanpa Stigma is an independent digital health education initiative. We are not an NGO, clinical service, diagnostic provider, or emergency service.

Public health portfolio

The experience behind this space.

Focused on community health, infectious-disease prevention, occupational safety, psychosocial support, and evidence-informed health communication.

HIV

HIV education & support

Experience in HIV peer counselling and field programme coordination in Bogor, with attention to health literacy, access to care, and stigma-free communication.

Study

Qualitative research

Research on psychosocial barriers to antiretroviral therapy adherence among adults newly diagnosed with HIV in Bogor.

OHS

Occupational health & safety

Experience supporting the health and safety of a workforce of more than 500 people, with three years of zero reported workplace accidents.

Care

Mental health support

Community-based support that helped more than 15 people reconnect with medication and mental-health services.

About the founder

Sifa's approach brings public-health rigour together with warm, accessible language. Ruang Tanpa Stigma is a place to publish writing, develop health communication, and document relevant work responsibly.

How we work

Values applied to every piece of content.

Evidence

Health information should be trustworthy, traceable, dated, and updated when guidance changes.

Empathy

Behind every medical term is a person with a life, relationships, choices, and a future.

Dignity

A person’s health status does not determine their worth. Language and design should reflect that respect.

Editorial standard

Draft → verify → source → language review → publish.

Indonesia’s Ministry of Health is the primary source for national policy and care pathways. WHO and UNAIDS support international information, with peer-reviewed literature used where needed.

Clinical content is not published simply because it sounds right. Incomplete or unreviewed work remains a draft and is hidden from readers.

An important boundary

This website provides general education and does not replace diagnosis, individual medical advice, or care from a qualified health professional.

Our guiding principle

A person should be able to understand HIV without feeling judged.

That is the standard for every page, sentence, and design decision at Ruang Tanpa Stigma.
